title: Act Two/Approval
html:
Overview Approval Inspiration

This page contains known companion approval that can be gained or lost within Act Two. The approval is organized by event or character, grouped by subregions which in turn are grouped by regions.

Ruined Battlefield

See also: Ruined Battlefield

Meeting Lassandra and the Harpers:

  • "A nightmare in the dark."  +1  +1  +1
  •  Bard "I find the best introductions are made while sitting around a fire, perhaps with drinks?"  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1
  •  Oath of Vengeance  +?  +?
  •  Druid "Peace - I am a druid."  -?
  • When Yonas succumbs to the curse:
    • Fight.  +1  +1  +1  +1
    • Run.  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1

Finding a Night Orchid:

  • Gift it to Shadowheart.  +5

Meeting  Gronag:

  • Demand he fetch the bone he threw into the darkness and then say "Go on. Fetch."  +1  +1  +1
  • Convince his Hyena to run away.  +1  +1  +1

Ambushing Kar'niss with the Harpers:

  • "The Absolute protected me."
    •  DC 14 Deception Check The Absolute guided me to you. She said I was to take yours.  +1  +1  +1  +1
      •  DC 14 Deception Check The Absolute has blessed you. You will be safe.  +1  +1  +1
      •  DC 14 Intimidation Check The Absolute wants you to go. Now!  +1  +1  +1
  • "Never mind that, there's a gang of Harpers ready to ambush you."  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1

Interacting with the Moonlantern:

  • After speaking with the pixie for a while: Ignore the pixie; keep the lantern.  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
  • Release the pixie.  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1

After rescuing Rolan from Shadows:

  •  Bard "If it helps, when I re-tell the story, I could say you killed all the monsters?"  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1
  •  Fighter "You were outmatched in that fight - there is no shame in that."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
  • "You were trying to help your family - you're too hard on yourself."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -2
  • "Shut up, and be grateful I saved your sorry tail."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1
  •  Wizard "A good wizard knows when to ask for guidance - for help."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1

Speaking with He Who Was:

  • "I doubt you're here out of the goodness of your heart."  +1  +1
  • "I will - what must I do?"  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • After obtaining Madeline's Ledger:
    •  DC 14 Persuasion Check "Anything? Then hurt yourself as Ben and Marc did - stab yourself."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
      • "Start stabbing, and don't stop until I say so." or "Prove you're sorry. Do it for Ben and Marc."  +2  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
        •  DC 16 Persuasion Check "Keep going." (Will cause combat.)  +5  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
        • "Stop. You've done enough."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -2
      • "Stop. You were willing to hurt yourself - that is enough for me."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -2
    •  DC 10 Persuasion Check "Pathetic - you murdered your friends. You're a coward."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
    •  DC 10 Persuasion Check "There's nothing you need do. This wasn't your fault - I promise."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1

Last Light Inn

See also: Last Light Inn

Meeting Jaheira at the entrance:

  • "Because of this artefact." (Show Jaheira.)  +1  +1
  • "I'm here on holiday."  +1

Speaking with Dammon if Karlach is in the party and having infernal iron:

  • Lay a hand on her or Pull her into a hug.  +5
  • Kiss her.  +10

Speaking with the Strange Ox:

  •  DC 14 Nature Check "You're a rare breed. An authentic Red-Backed River Ox. I thought you'd be more discerning..."  +1
  • If it shared its thoughts with you: "Your secret - whatever it is - is safe with me."  +1  +1  +1

Speaking with Bex about Danis underneath the bridge:

  • "Is there any thing I can do to help?"
    • Saying you'll bring him back.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
    • "From what I've heard, they've probably killed and eaten him. In that order, if he's lucky."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
  • "Sounds like your boy toy's goblin chow."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1

Speaking with Halsin just outside the safe barrier after waking Art Cullagh:

  • "You can count on me."  +1  +1  +1

Ground Floor

Speaking with Mattis if Karlach is in the party:

  • "'Scamming with the greats?' What kind of advice is that?"  -5
  • "You were too nice to that little runt."  -5
  • If you offer to buy the key, then say that's way too little:  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1

 DC 10 Medicine Check Speaking with Jaheira after smelling the wine:

  • Drink the wine.  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1
  • Decline to drink.  +3  +1  +1  +1  +1

Speaking with Cerys about Zevlor and the tieflings:

  • "So you abandoned them."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
  • "You did right. You do not want to be a prisoner of the Absolute."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1

Helping Mol with lanceboard against Raphael:

  •  Bard, follow Gale's advice, put pressure on him, or  Sleight of Hand Check.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • Fall back, say he's the devil, or say you've never played.  -1  -1  -1
  • If you bring Astarion and Raphael reveals his scars for the first time, say "Gods... the carving must have been excruciating."  +1

Speaking with Alfira:

  • "Just take it one step at a time."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  •  Bard or "Danger is my life - I wouldn't change it for the world."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • "I don't complain constantly. It's very annoying."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
  • When she asks you to go to Moonrise Towers:
    • "Don't worry, I'll find them."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
    • "I imagine the cultists are torturing them right now."  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1

Speaking with Rolan at the bar about his siblings:

  • "Do you know where they are?"
    • "They're better off dead than in the cult's hands."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
    • "If they're alive, I'll rescue them."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
  • "Then it's my responsibility to bring them back."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
  • "Stop whining and do something about it."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1

Speaking with Ide:

  • "Ignore him - he's more immature than you are."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • Convincing Ide to hand over the magic book:
    •  DC 14 Deception Check "If you give it to me, I'll make sure he gets it."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
    •  DC 14 Intimidation Check "Give it to me, you brat. Now."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
    •  DC 14 Persuasion Check "Do you really want to give it to him after how he acted?"  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1

Speaking with Florrick about Moonrise Towers:

  • "Are the Flaming Fist going to stand around here?"  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • "I have no intention of heading there."  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1

Speaking with Manip Vidor about heading to Moonrise Towers:

  • "Doing your job, you mean."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1

Speaking with His Majesty:

  • "My intentions are pure. I only wanted to admire you up close."  +2  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1
    • Quietly admire the cat.  +2  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1
  •  DC 14 Intimidation Check to Hiss, then "You're in my territory. Get out."  +2  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -2

Speaking with the tiefling children after the attack:

  • "She's probably dead already."  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1

Speaking with Art Cullagh after finding his lute:

  • Pull out the lute you found and play a little.  +1  +1  +1

Speaking with Wulbren and Barcus after freeing the Moonrise Towers prisoners:

  • "Prick."  +1 +1 +1 -1

First Floor

Speaking with Isobel and Marcus:

  • "I say we follow the winged freak."  +1
  • When she asks what's going on:
    • "Marcus is trying to kidnap you, Isobel. We're going to need to fight our way out of this one."  +10  +10  +10  +10  +5  +1  +1  -5
    • "You're going to meet Ketheric - face-to-face."  -10  -10  -10  -10  -5  -5

Sharran Sanctuary

See also: Sharran Sanctuary

Interacting with the Shar Altar:

  • Perform the blood offering.  +1
  • Steal the dagger.  -1

Reithwin Town

See also: Reithwin Town

Speaking with Arabella:

  • "I'll find your parents - you can count on me." +3  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1
    • "Of course. You can stay in my camp." +3  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1
    • "Forget it. No kids in my camp."  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -3
  • "Forget it, kid. You can take care of yourself, from the looks of it."  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -3
  • Avoid meeting Arabella in Act Two until you find her parents. Afterwards, tell her that they will never return.  +1

Reithwin Tollhouse

See also: Reithwin Tollhouse

Speaking with Gerringothe Thorm:

  • Pay one gold, then successfully convince her to end herself by any available option.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • Give up all your gold to Gerringothe Thorm.  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1
  • "I bring you death."  +1  +1

House of Healing

See also: House of Healing

Speaking with Malus Thorm:

  • Convince Malus Thorm to order his sisters to hone their blades on each other.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
    • Then persuade Malus Thorm to operate on himself.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • OR Convince Malus Thorm to take the place of his patient and submit to sisters' curing.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1(comes one point by another subsequently)
  • Attack.  +1  +1

The Waning Moon

See also: The Waning Moon

Speaking with Thisobald Thorm:

  • "No. I will not drink." or Attack.  +1  +1
  • Pass the first  DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw to drink or the first  DC 18 Sleight of Hand Check to mime drinking.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • Pass the first  Performance Check to tell a story, or fail but then pass the  DC 18 Deception Check.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • "No. I will not share my stories."  +1  +1
  • Pass the second  DC 16 Constitution Saving Throw to drink.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • Pass the second  Performance Check to tell a story, or fail but then pass the  DC 18 Deception Check.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • Refuse to tell more stories.  +1  +1
  • Pass the third  DC 18 Constitution Saving Throw to drink or the third  DC 21 Sleight of Hand Check to mime drinking.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1

House in Deep Shadows

See also: House in Deep Shadows

Speaking with Oliver:

  • Agree to play hide-and-seek with Oliver.  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1
    • Then say you've changed your mind.(Immediately starts the fight with Oliver's 'family.')  +1  -1
  • Agree to play hide-and-seek again.  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1
  • Beat Oliver at hide-and-seek without being spotted.  +1
  • "I know who you really are, and where you really belong. You need to reunite with Thaniel."  +1
  • After going through the portal and defeating Oliver's summons:
    • "You're just a thieving shadow that think it's a child. Playtime's over - Thaniel's waiting."  -1
    • "People are dying for the sake of your fun, kid."  -1
    • "Talk to him, Halsin. You know what needs to be said better than anyone."  +10
  • Convince Oliver to reunite with Thaniel.  +40  +5  +3  +1

Moonrise Towers

See also: Moonrise Towers

Entering the building:

  • "I've infiltrated an encampment of Harpers protected by a cleric of Selûne."  -1  -1  -1  -1
  • "Great news: I'm here to take your head."  +1  +1  +1

Main Floor

Speaking with Lann Tarv:

  • Refuse to take Soul Coins from Lann Tarv in exchange for hearing about the souls inside them.  -5

▶ Note: This line appears only if Karlach is in the party.

In the Throne Room:

  • Kill the goblins without combat (through dialogue options).  +1  -1  -1
  • Offer the goblins a fair fight.  +1  +1  -1
  • Order the guards to release the goblins.  +1  -1  -1  -1

In the Kitchen:

  •  DC 16 Wisdom Check Sever the connection between Linsella and Barnabus.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1

Speaking with Araj Oblodra:

  • "Excuse me? He's his own person." +5  +1  +1
    • Stand by Astarion's decision. +5  +1  +1  -1  -1
  • "He does what I tell him, if that's what you mean."  -3
  • Convince or order Astarion to drink Araj Oblodra's blood.  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -3

Speaking with Disciple Z'rell:

  • If you freed the goblins:
    • Tell her that you're going to free the prisoners in the jail cells next.  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
    •  DC 16 Persuasion Check "They won't get far..."  +1  +1  +1
    •  DC 16 Deception Check "Dead, they're a waste..."  +1  +1  +1
  • Successfully distract her with "your lusts for Astarion" when she searches your mind for proof of your faith.  +1 or
  • Successfully distract her with "your yearning for Gale."  +1 or
  • Successfully distract her with "your aching for Karlach."  +1

▶ Note: These options are available only if you're romancing the companion.

  • Ask Disciple Z'rell to show the power the Absolute has given her.  +1

Prison

Talking to Questioners Sumera and Jasin when Minthara is being erased:[verify]

  • "I expected her to be dismembered. Disappointing."  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
  • "The only thing I'm going to break is you."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
    • Save her, then kill her.  -1  -1  -1  -1
    • Invite Minthara to your camp after saving her.  +5  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1

Speaking with The Warden:[verify]

  • When trying to convince her to let you speak with the prisoners:
    • Bribe.  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1
    • Refuse to bribe.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1

Speaking with Wulbren:[verify]

  • "Are you Wulbren? Barcus sent me."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1

Assaulting Moonrise Towers

  • Invite Jaheira to fight with you in front of Moonrise Towers.  +5
  • After the first floor is secured, tell Jaheira you sense a bit of envy and ask her to join the fight against Ketheric Thorm.  +?
  • At the Moonrise Towers Rooftop, tell Ketheric Thorm that seeing your enemies cowed never gets old.  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • At the Moonrise Towers Rooftop, tell Ketheric Thorm that you can help, or that it isn't too late, or to come quietly.  +1  +1  +1  +1

▶ Note: The Moonrise Towers Rooftop options require a  DC 21 Intimidation Check and any of subsequent  DC 30 Ability Checks first OR a  DC 10 Persuasion Check if you have found and read Melodia's Letter to Ketheric.

  • If Ketheric Thorm has surrendered, tell Aylin to stand down.  +1  +1  +1  +1

After killing Ketheric Thorm:

  • Speaking with Minthara:
    • "It suits you."  +1
    • "And I'll never tire of killing their previous occupants. We make a good team."  +1  +10
    • Tell her you can hardly wait to reshape the world.  +1  +5
    • Propose to take Orin's place to lead the cult of Absolute.  +5  +5  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1
  • Accept Minthara's proposal to seize control of The Netherbrain.  +5  +5  -1  -1  -1
  • Reject Minthara's proposal to seize control of The Netherbrain.  +1  +1  +1  -1  -3
  • "If you go to Baldur's Gate, you're going alone."  -1  -1
  • When Minthara asks about the one thing that needs explaining:
    • "Coming here was my best chance to learn more about the tadpole. Possibly even cure it."  +10  +1  +1
    • "I want revenge on those who did this to me."  +10  +1  +1
    • "I was just looking for more people to kill."  -1
    • Say that you attacked the Grove to impress her.  +3
  • After Minthara gets up from the throne:
    • Ask whether she respected Ketheric.  +1
    • When discussing her joining the cult of the Absolute, comment on her pride or that it's understandable.  +1
    • Promise she will have her revenge on Orin.  +5
  • Speaking with Art Cullagh:[verify]
    • "Then I wish you luck. Thank you for your help."  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • Speaking with Cerys:[verify]
    • "You deserve some of the credit - they look up to you."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
    • "I couldn't have done it without Jaheira, and the Harpers."  +1  +1  +2  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
    • "Nightsong's the real hero here - she was the light in the darkness."  +1  +1  +1  +2  +1  -1  -1  -1
    • "People get paid for doing jobs - cough up the coin."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
    • Speaking of Zevlor:
      • "You shouldn't speak ill of the dead - Zevlor did his best."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1
      • "Good riddance."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1
  • Speaking with Alfira:[verify]
    • Agree to play with her.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
  • Speaking with Jaheira:
    • Say that she seems to enjoy herself, then tell you're having the time of your life, too.  +1  +1  +1
    • Telling her, "Join me now." Or "I'll see you at camp."  +1
  • Speaking to Umi about Mol's eyepatch:[verify]
    • "Hey, calm down - I'm sure she just dropped it. Mol's fine, I promise."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
    • "Dead - like you'll be soon, you little runt."  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
  • Speaking to Mattis about Mol's eyepatch:[verify]
    • "It's all right - I'm sure Mol will be waiting for you at Baldur's Gate."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1
    • "Mol's dead - you and I both know it. Death happens. Grow up."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
  • Speaking to Ide about Mol's eyepatch:[verify]
    • "Somewhere unpleasant. But I didn't see Mol - she's probably safe somewhere"  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1
    • "What does it matter? Your friend's dead anyway."  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1

Gauntlet of Shar

See also: Gauntlet of Shar

Interacting with the Pedestal of Reckoning:

  • Agree to help Shadowheart with the trials.  +5  +1  +1  +1  -1  -1  -1
  • Tell Shadowheart you will support her becoming a Dark Justiciar.  -?
  • Tell Shadowheart that passing the trials is a distraction or that you're only here to uncover Ketheric's secrets.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -5
  • After installing an Umbral Gem into the Pedestal of Reckoning, tell Shadowheart that searching the Spear of Night is nonsense.  -1

At the Altar to Shar:

  •  DC 14 Religion Check Pray at the altar.  +5

Speaking with the Reconstituted Duellist:

  •  Rogue Say that you do not blunder.  +?  +?
  • Shadowheart Say you are a believer of Shar.  +?
  • "You leave. I don't answer to bone piles."  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1

Speaking with Balthazar:

  •  DC 14 Persuasion Check Convince Balthazar to give you the bell to summon Flesh.  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • Having Mother Dearest in your inventory, ask Balthazar what happened to his mother. Then, tell him you took the urn, and finally say that you'll keep her.  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1
  • Agree to help him.  -1  -1  -1  -1  -1
  • Attack.  +5  +1  +1  +1  +1

At each trial:

  • Let Shadowheart step up at the sacrificial bowl.  +5
  • Tell Shadowheart to stand down.  -1

When dealing with Yurgir:

  • Attack.  +5  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • Attack after listening to his pact.  +5
